text:
Ana: quick FYI - noticed TOC anchors on /guides/api/usage jump to the wrong spots after yesterday's markdown tidy. Also one JS snippet in the 'auth flow' section is using old client.create() API and is failing our docs CI.
Ravi: thanks Ana. Which anchor? and CI log?
Ana: anchor -> #rate-limits (it goes to the 'examples' h3 instead). CI log: https://ci.redwood.ai/gh/docs/98765 -> linter fails on sample line 42 (uses client.create). I repro locally.
docs-bot: nightly-snippet-check: flagged 1 deprecated-api usage and 2 misaligned anchors on /guides/api/usage (scan ref: snippets-2026-03-21-01).
Ravi: I'll take the page. Plan: 1) normalize header ids (use explicit header IDs where ambiguous), 2) replace deprecated sample with client.openStream(), 3) run docs linkcheck and snippet tests.
Kai: ping @Ravi re: quick CR — could you add a tiny unit test for the snippet harness so we don't regress again? If it's trivial, we can merge with 1 reviewer.
Ravi: yep will add a test. Also will keep the PR small so we can canary deploy.
Ana: customer note: support found this during onboarding but not yet customer-facing. Low severity but good to fix before next release.
Ravi: opening PR now. sed commands I used: sed -n '1,200p' docs/guides/api/usage.md | sed -e "s/client.create(/client.openStream(/g" > tmp && mv tmp docs/guides/api/usage.md
(20m later) Ravi: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4299 1 updates: explicit header ids, replace sample with client.openStream(), add snippet harness test. Requesting @Kai review.
Kai: quick scan LGTM. Left 1 comment about test naming. @deploy-bot can we get a preview link?
deploy-bot: preview available at https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/guides/api/usage?pr=4299 (expires 48h).
(30m later) Ravi: merged and deployed canary. Linkcheck passed, snippet tests green in CI, preview validated by Ana.
Ana: verified preview and local onboarding flow. Thanks! Can someone file a short follow-up so we add snippet harness test to the docs PR checklist?
Kai: filed issue #1010: "Add snippet harness test step to docs PR checklist" and added checklist bullet in CONTRIBUTING.md.
Ravi: closing loop here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
